original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the Bucket field status.artifact.digest is newly required, and Bucket objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: Comparing the install bundles from [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0), the validators confirmed that status.artifact.digest is in the Bucket schema in both releases. They also confirmed that the field becomes required only in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema. The subject is therefore correct, and setting version=v1beta2 is right because the change applies to that one API version. The change type now-required matches the computed field-required diff exactly.
